candidates.title: Author Event: Celebrate the Mooncake Festival with Jasmine Fang
candidates.audiences: Kids (6-11); Pre-schoolers (3-5); Tweens (11-13)
candidates.description: Join us for a special event featuring children's author Jasmine Fang! Jasmine will read her debut picture book, Beneath the Same Round Moon, then lead participants through a craft activity in celebration of the Autumn Moon Festival. Participants will have the chance to win a copy of Beneath the Same Round Moon (must be present to win!) . There will be an author signing at the conclusion of the program. Linden Tree Books will be providing copies of Jasmine's book to purchase. Jasmine Fang is the author of Beneath the Same Round Moon (Beaming Books, September 2026) and the forthcoming Our Chinatown Market (Penguin Viking, Spring 2028). A former government and higher education professional turned author, she draws on a decade of work and travel across 30+ countries, and a lifelong love of story, to write books rooted in heart and wonder. Jasmine now lives in the San Francisco Bay Area with her husband and children. Find her online at jasmineifang.com or on Instagram @jasmineifang .

candidates.description: Now in our fourth year of partnership with Music at Kohl Mansion, we proudly present the Escher String Quartet. The Escher String Quartet has established itself as one of the most accomplished chamber ensembles of its generation. Formed in New York City in 2005, and named after the Dutch graphic artist M.C. Escher, the quartet is celebrated for performances that combine technical brilliance, interpretive insight, and a distinctive ensemble sound. The group serves as Artists of the Chamber Music Society of Lincoln Center and has earned international recognition for its commitment to both the core string quartet repertoire and contemporary music. The quartet has appeared at many of the world’s leading concert halls and festivals, including London’s Wigmore Hall, Amsterdam’s Concertgebouw, the Kennedy Center, Paris’s Auditorium du Louvre, and major chamber music festivals throughout North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. Praised by critics for their precision, warmth, and expressive depth, the Escher String Quartet has received numerous honors, including the prestigious Avery Fisher Career Grant and Lincoln Center’s Martin E. The ensemble’s critically acclaimed recording projects include the complete string quartets of Alexander Zemlinsky and Felix Mendelssohn and more. Through its adventurous programming and consistently compelling performances, the Escher String Quartet continues to be recognized as one of the leading chamber ensembles on the international stage.

candidates.title: Music & Movement
candidates.audiences: Babies (under 2); Kids (6-11); Pre-schoolers (3-5); Toddlers (18 mos. to 3 yrs)
candidates.description:
Bring your dancing feet to the Mitchell Park Library on Wednesday evenings for Music & Movement with Librarian Celina. Build early literacy skills through movement, songs, and dance. This week, we'll be celebrating Native American Heritage Month.

 Instruments, songs, and dance moves will all be introduced so that everyone will be able to enjoy moving along to the music.

 This program is meant for families with children and no previous experience is needed!

candidates.title: Bilingual Family Storytime
candidates.audiences: Babies (under 2); Pre-schoolers (3-5); Toddlers (18 mos. to 3 yrs)
candidates.description: Join Señorita Juliana for Bilingual Family Storytime at the College Terrace Library! Enjoy stories, songs, rhymes, and movement activities in Spanish and English . Thursdays from 10:30-11 AM. Follow us on YouTube for more stories, songs, and rhymes, including a playlist of our favorites! ¡Participa con la Señorita Juliana en la Hora Cuentos Bilingüe en la Biblioteca College Terrace! Disfruta de cuentos, canciones, rimas y actividades con movimiento en Español e Inglés . Jueves de 10:30-11 AM. La Hora de Cuentos se realizará adentro o al aire libre, dependiendo del clima. ¡Síguenos en YouTube para ver más cuentos, canciones y rimas, incluyendo una lista de reproducción con nuestros favoritos!
candidates.tips: Storytime may be held indoors or outdoors depending on the weather.

candidates.title: Smart Start Babytime
candidates.audiences: Preschoolers; Parents; Families; Toddlers
candidates.description: Smart Start Babytime is a special program for babies (0–2) and their caregivers that blends stories, songs, and early play with different information each week with a pediatric resident from Stanford Medical School.
